notes.title: Demo update 24 is now live!
notes.notes: [p]The latest demo update is here, bringing big improvements to the gameplay experience:[/p][list][*][p][b]Smoother Player Onboarding[/b] – New UI elements and tutorial cues make it easier than ever to jump in and survive your first night.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Overhaul[/b] – Cleaner visuals and better menus for an improved, more immersive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Expanded Input Support[/b] – Better controller support and rebindable keys for maximum comfort.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Train Level Reworks[/b] – Updated puzzles, improved pacing, and refined encounters to keep the tension high from start to finish.[/p][/*][/list][p]Whether you’re a first-time survivor or a returning veteran, now is the perfect time to hop back in and test your skills.[/p]

notes.title: Major Demo Update – Fairer Boss, Loadout Rework, and UI Polish!
notes.notes:
[p]The nightmare just got deeper.[/p][p]This major update to the Necrosis: Dawn of Dread demo brings sharper teeth, better tools for survival, and a new layer of polish to every corner of the experience.[/p][p]What’s new:[/p][p][b]Rebalanced Boss Fight[/b]
The first major encounter is still lethal, but is now better balanced. Expect a fairer fight without losing the fear.[/p][p][b]Updated Character Loadouts[/b]
Every survivor now comes equipped with a light source and a last-resort melee weapon. You're still vulnerable, but never defenseless.[/p][p][b]UI and Gameplay Improvements[/b]
Menus are cleaner. Interactions are smoother. The world feels more immersive and responsive.[/p][p][b]Refined Balance and Pacing[/b]
Tension has been adjusted based on community feedback to sharpen the survival experience without dulling the edge.[/p][p][/p][p]Step back into the outbreak. The dark is waiting.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update: More Content. More Chaos. No Mercy.
notes.notes:
[p]Necrosis: Dawn of Dread isn't slowing down — it's speeding up. While other games drip-feed patches, [b]we're dropping updates like it's an outbreak.[/b] This latest demo build brings new polish, balance tweaks, and quality-of-life upgrades based directly on your feedback.[/p][p]We're not just refining the experience — [b]we're rewriting the rules of survival horror[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]⚔ [b]Combat improvements[/b] that make every shot matter[/p][/*][*][p]🧠 [b]Smarter zombie behavior[/b] — because panic shouldn't be predictable[/p][/*][*][p]🔧 [b]Performance boosts and bug fixes[/b] to keep the game as smooth as your aim[/p][/*][*][p]💀 [b]More polish to visuals, UI, and balance[/b] — because we're not shipping anything half-baked[/p][/*][/list][p]And we’re just getting started. [b]Major updates hit constantly[/b]. The outbreak’s evolving fast — and so are we.
[b]Play the demo. Spread the word. Wishlist the game.[/b]
Because when the apocalypse hits, you'll want to say you were here first.[/p]
